tr.source: UM10204 Rev. 7.0, Table 11, page 44: tr of SDA and SCL in Fast-mode (400 kHz), 20 to 300 ns from 0.3 VDD to 0.7 VDD. For Standard-mode (100 kHz) the same row gives 1000 ns at most and no least; for Fast-mode Plus (1 MHz), 120 ns at most and no least

isink_share.source: UM10204 Rev. 7.0, Table 10, page 43: a Standard- or Fast-mode device sinks 3 mA at VOL1 0.4 V for VDD over 2 V (IOL), and a Fast-mode device 2 mA at VOL2 0.2 VDD for VDD at 2 V or below; the deck divides the current the pull-up asks for by the one its VDD calls for, so the pull-up may ask no more than 1 of it (Fast-mode Plus: 20 mA at 0.4 V)
